units.source_text: 据说，北山杉林全是私人经营，

en.t: It was said that the Kitayama cedar forests were all privately managed,

units.source_text: 但并不是所有人家都拥有山地。

en.t: but not every household owned mountain land.
There were not many people who owned mountain land.

units.source_text: 千重子想：自己的亲生父母大概是拥有山地的人家的雇工吧。

en.t: Chieko thought that her birth parents had probably been hired workers for a family that owned mountain land.

units.source_text: 苗子本人也曾说过：“我是当雇工的……”

en.t: Naeko herself had once said, "I work as a hired hand..."
